description: Source code and metadata-only evidence for a board-aware PCB defect-detection study of same-board exposure, reproducible evaluation contracts, and calibration-only deployment validation.
notes: No dataset pixels, model weights, ONNX exports, or TensorRT engines are included. The upstream dataset license remains unverified; model and export redistribution rights are not asserted. Performance evidence is calibration-only where stated and is not a production SLA. Aggregate L4 fidelity passed, while strict per-box parity failed for both exported backends under frozen thresholds.
title: PCB Defect Detection: Leakage-Aware Evaluation and Deployment Evidence
